title: Croatian Mushroom Wrap
description: A flavorful and savory wrap filled with sautéed mushrooms and served with a tangy zesty sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the zesty sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Warm the silky wrap in the microwave or in a dry skillet for a few seconds.
Spoon the mushroom mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
